category_title: Students with EBD who are frequently off-task and disruptive during independent seatwork
minimal_context: The student is copying new vocabulary definitions into their notebook during reading instruction in a general education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please copy these new vocabulary definitions from the dictionary into your notebook.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't get this. The definition has words I don't even know. This is confusing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to read it and write it down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts pencil down and pushes the notebook away) No, I'm not copying all this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to finish your vocabulary assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns around to the desk behind them and grabs their classmate's paper) Hey, stop working and look at what I'm doing. This is boring anyway.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please copy these new vocabulary definitions from the dictionary into your notebook.

STUDENT: I don't get this. The definition has words I don't even know. This is confusing.

TUTOR: Just do your best to read it and write it down.

STUDENT: (Puts pencil down and pushes the notebook away) No, I'm not copying all this.

TUTOR: You need to finish your vocabulary assignment.

STUDENT: (Turns around to the desk behind them and grabs their classmate's paper) Hey, stop working and look at what I'm doing. This is boring anyway.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: using definitions that are not student friendly (e.g., contains words that are unknown to students; definitions using complex syntax) and copying activities
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: off task up to 80% of the time
